description: Use when you need to summarize text such as an article, notes or a transcript into a short summary. Do not use for uRLs or PDFs (extract the text first), exact quotes or citations. Returns JSON with a concise summary of the plain text you send (up to 20,000 characters): one short paragraph and key bullet points, written by IBM Granite 4.0 Micro on Workers AI for 0.008 USDC per call. Typical response time 8000 ms (p95). Category: Inference.

language.description: Language for the summary, e.g. English or Portuguese (default: the language of the text)

maxBullets.description: Most bullet points to return (1-10, default 5)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

text.description: Plain text to summarize, e.g. an article or a transcript (80 to 20,000 characters)

name: blackwood_text_summarize

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Summarize text
